intro: Amaramaina Prema is the latest Telugu Christian song from 32nd album, Srikaruda Naa Yesayya written, tuned by Hosanna Ministries and sung by Senior Pastor, Singer, song-writer by Pastor John Wesley. This worship song video was released on March 03, 2022 through Hosanna Ministries YouTube channel.
